items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Somebody said, Sam...' and later refers to 'that old guy' and 'booking agents', but does not explicitly identify 'Sam' as the person he is interacting with or having a specific professional relationship with beyond a general mention.

ctx.x: Somebody said, Sam, I'm up there, man, you must be getting plenty of money, eh? I said, well, I'm doing all right. He said, well, you're getting your money? I said, well, no, I'm letting it pile up, I'm gonna, when I go home. So the guy laughed at me, you know. I said, well, what do you mean? So I said, but you, if you know what I know, you better get your money. So I went, I went up to see the guy, you know, and, uh, about three times, every time I go there, he wasn't in, or he's in conference, you know, that,…

So I go down to the office and I look back and I see him sitting back in the office with his feet up on the desk, you see. And the receptionist tells me he's busy. He's in conference. I said yes, I slammed the data open and walked out to him, look I want my money. So he laughed at me, you know. I said I want my money. Don't fool with me if you fool me but don't fool with my money, you see. So I said, what you gonna do? I said what I'm gonna do, I'm gonna go to the union, that's what I'm gonna do. So I said go…
